Deltana 98C2008, 98C Series Traditional 6" Bathroom Towel Ring

The classic steeped rose of Deltana's 6" Towel Ring makes it perfect for any traditional style decor. Crafted out of solid brass, the 98C Series Towel Ring features concealed screw mounting for a sleek look. It is large enough for the thickest full-sized towels but not so bulky that hand towels would look out of place hanging from it. It is available in satin nickel, polished chrome, and oil rubbed bronze finishes. This bathroom towel ring is made with the attention to quality that Deltana is known for.

Shop more of the Deltana 98C Series Bathroom Accessories

Features and Specifications of the 98C Solid Brass Classic 6" Bathroom Towel Ring:

  • Ring Diameter: 5-3/8"
  • Overall Width: 6-3/8"
  • Overall Length: 7-3/8"
  • Projection: 3-1/8"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Deltana 98C2008 6" Bathroom Towel Ring Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 towel ring, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.
